title: Metro Channel Presents "A Taste of Spain," Featuring Nico Bolzico and Wil Dasovich
summary: The two-part travel series brings together two of today’s recognizable personalities for an immersive exploration of Southern Spain’s iconic destinations, culinary heritage, and local traditions.
